description: Traffic Poles with CCTV DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. Location of 241 CCTV traffic poles within Dublin City Council administrative area. This dataset contains Road1, Latitude and Longitude values. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are CCTV, Roads and Transport, Security, Traffic. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, DB_TABLE, GEOJSON, KML, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
